title: Settings information architecture

current.rowCount: 33 possible rows in 5 groups, 17 of them gated; a connected Android phone on a catalog server sees about 31
current.depth: Hub, page, sheet or dialog, then a nested layer. Four layers deep: Model and mode > sheet > Options dialog > Agent dropdown; Plugins > AI Team sheet > team-host-sheet; Chat > Older drafts > review sheet > delete sheet.
current.duplicates: model x2 (same brain icon and view), privacy x2, notices x2, AI Team x3, background battery x2, bug reporting x2 with different destinations
current.search: One index (lib/ui/search/search_index.dart) serves the hub and the chat command launcher: 33 hub rows, 20 inside entries (Notifications 4, Appearance 3, Usage 4, Commands & tools 4, On this phone 3, Saved servers 1, Setup guide 1) and 12 destinations. Matching is word-AND substring over title, keywords and parent (search_index.dart:135), with title matches ranked first. There is no typo tolerance, no ranking by use and no highlight on arrival. Aliases are bilingual (en/ar).
searchGaps: Effects (glass, animations, celebrations, vibration) are not indexed: 'vibration' finds nothing (app_en.arb:17221)
Keep running is keyed only on its subtitle: 'battery' finds Notifications, and 'heat' or 'thermal' find nothing (search_index.dart:446)
the alias 'font text size' leads to Appearance, which has no text-size control
the alias 'Older drafts' leads to Privacy, which does not hold them (search_index.dart:601)
not indexed: individual providers, MCP servers, plugins, models, saved rules, and features on Available on this server

proposedIA: 1. Top: one KitSearchField over every setting, including rows inside pages. Add typo tolerance and synonyms, and open the page scrolled to the row with a brief highlight. Fix the dead aliases.

2. Under search, one 'Ask the setup assistant' row (needs server.any + model.auth): a conversation with a configuration agent that researches, proposes and applies OpenCode config (providers, MCP, plugins, models, permissions). It is the same agent as MCP setup (owner, j2 mcp-setup) and is offered when search finds nothing. Manual rows stay as the fallback.
3. One KitStatusLine for what needs attention: background stopped by Android, provider not loaded, plugin failed, new errors to report. Only the most important one shows.
4. Server (3): This server (status, restart, update, Disconnect inside), Servers (saved, Tailscale, external agents inside), On this phone.

5. Agent (4): Model (one row: model, agent, thinking; the catalog inside), Providers and accounts, Tools (MCP, commands, skills, plugins as sections), AI Team (one home; the Settings row, Plugins row and team-plugin-sheet all land on team-home, or team-intro when off).
6. Conversations (5): Always allowed actions, Default shell (read-only when only one), Show reasoning and Show timestamps and usage as inline switches, Voice.

7. This phone (5): Notifications (what notifies me and quiet hours only), Keep running (background switch, Android daily limit, battery, heat), Appearance (inline light/dark), Privacy and data (sizes of all local data, older drafts migrated to Saved prompts, share read state, policy), Usage.

8. Help (4): Setup guide (with 'Add a server' and a phone path), Report a problem (Report a bug and App diagnostics merged, error count badge), Available on this server (missing features first, each with 'How to get it'), About (version, open source including voice licences, Show tips again).
9. Moves out: Import conversation goes to the Work tab. Keyboard shortcuts stays desktop-only in Help. Plugin command links and the unreachable agent dialog are removed.
10. About 21 rows instead of 33, with no duplicate pairs. At most 5 rows per group, and one icon per row.
11. Depth: at most hub, page, sheet. No dialog over a sheet: agent, options and unloaded-providers move into the model sheet, and the revoke dialog becomes a confirm sheet.
12. Gated rows stay absent (rule 7). The group shows one muted line, 'N settings need a newer server · Why', linking to Available on this server.
13. One error hook, openReportProblem(context, error:), wired into KitStateView and KitNotice error tones, so every failure offers 'Report this' with the error attached.
14. Header: 'Settings' as the page title in both the embedded and pushed states, with the server as the small line.
